mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in the real retail sales index (RSAFS) signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in periods of declining RSAFS are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
